lunar_regolith_undisturbed.notes: Fine-grained basaltic lunar soil with micro-porous structure and jagged agglutinates

lunar_regolith_compressed_tracks.notes: Compacted soil in astronaut boot tracks and equipment cart wheels; appears markedly darker than virgin surface

kapton_aluminized_foil_gold.notes: Multi-Layer Insulation (MLI) blankets on LM descent stage; highly crinkled specular foil

kapton_copper_amber.notes: Secondary thermal blanket foil used on select quadrant bulkheads

inconel_dps_engine_bell.notes: Columbium radiation-cooled nozzle bell, discolored by hypergolic combustion exhaust

surveyor_weathered_white_paint.notes: Originally bright white TiO2 paint, degraded to tan/sepia after 31 months of solar UV and LM blast

surveyor_7075_aluminum_struts.notes: Polished structural aluminum alloy with subtle sandblasted matte texture on windward sides

alsep_beryllium_rtg_casing.notes: High-temperature beryllium metal casing and radial cooling fins operating at ~590°C

spacesuit_beta_cloth.notes: Woven silica fiber (Beta cloth) outer layer of A7L spacesuit

spacesuit_dust_smudge.notes: Heavy regolith smudging on boots, shins, knees, and suit arms caused by electrostatic adhesion
